Applicant Dropbox, Inc. (“Dropbox”) hereby moves, pursuant to TBMP § 510, to
suspend this proceeding pending resolution of Dropbox’s motion to consolidate Opposition No.
91200450 and Opposition No. 91201367. Counsel to Opposer YouSendIt, Inc. (“YouSendIt”)
consented to this request via an e-mail message dated February 21, 2012.

Dropbox requested this relief in connection with its February 7, 2012 renewed motion to
consolidate, but the Board has yet to rule on that motion. Given the approaching pre-trial and
trial deadlines in this proceeding, and in the interest of caution, Dropbox is now filing the same
stay request as a separate motion.

Proceedings may be suspended for good cause upon motion or upon stipulation of the
parties approved by the Board. TBMP § 510.03. Dropbox respectfully suggests that good cause
exists where, as here, the parties have stipulated to the request and the Board is considering a
motion that may implicate an added party and rescheduling of the pre-trial and trial deadlines.
The parties should have the benefit of knowing whether or not consolidation is to occur before
proceeding further with their respective claims and defenses.

-1-

For the foregoing reasons, Dropbox respectfully requests that the Board suspend these
proceedings pending resolution of the motion to consolidate.
